en: The image shows a black-and-white photograph of a wooden church with a prominent cross at the top of its steeply pitched roof. The building has large windows and is surrounded by a few leafless trees, possibly birches, and a simple wooden fence. There is a dirt road or path in the foreground, and a ladder leaning on the side of the building. The style is modest, typical of rural northern or eastern European Protestant or Orthodox churches. There is a handwritten number in the upper left corner (possibly a catalog or archival number: '10,55').
